travel.title: See you at Villa Valentina.
travel.carText: Set your navigation to Villa Valentina, Via Donizetti 17, Tradate (VA). Follow the directions and park right at the villa.
travel.trainText: The Trenord Milano Cadorna–Saronno–Varese line, when it is behaving, stops at Tradate. Let us know in advance if you need a lift from the station.
